copy.headline: The no-pull harness with their name on it
copy.lede: Sized to your dog, hand-finished with their name, built for the muddiest walk in Britain.
copy.body_html: Front and back D-rings redirect the pull instead of restraining it. Padded Y-front keeps pressure off the throat. Four adjustment points for a real fit, reinforced bar-tack stitching where cheap harnesses fail.
bullets: Front clip that actually stops the pulling
Padded Y-front — no pressure on the throat
Four adjustment points for a true fit
copy.proof: Modelar prova social de RuffRover (contagem de reviews acima do CTA) e Luther Bennett (selo Trustpilot). Sem reviews inventadas no lançamento.

faq.q: What if the size is wrong?
faq.a: Free exchange within 30 days — keep the first one until the new size arrives.
Ships in 2–4 working days from our UK partner, then 2–3 days delivery.

faq.q: Is it good for a heavy puller?
faq.a: Yes — use the front clip; it redirects rather than restrains.

pages.title: Shipping & Delivery
pages.body_html: Orders ship from the UK. Standard delivery 3–6 working days. Personalised items add 2–4 working days for finishing. Free delivery over £30, otherwise £3.95. Tracking emailed on dispatch.

pages.title: Returns & Exchanges
pages.body_html: 30-day fit guarantee: if the size is wrong, we swap it free — keep the first one on until the new one arrives. Unused non-personalised items refundable within 30 days. Personalised items only replaced if faulty. Modelled on the "no-quibble" language used by qualified competitors in this research.

pages.title: Sizing Guide
pages.body_html: Measure chest girth behind the front legs and neck at the base. Match to the table; if between sizes, size up. XS 28–38cm chest … XL 78–96cm chest.

pages.title: Contact Us
pages.body_html: Email hello@trotterandco.co.uk — we reply within one working day (UK hours).

pages.title: About Trotter & Co
pages.body_html: Started by UK dog owners tired of harnesses that rubbed, frayed and looked like everyone else’s. One kit, sized properly, with their name on it.

pages.title: Reviews

production_notes: Cada anúncio: 1 gancho + 1 ângulo + 1 objeção. Rodar 5 no lançamento, cortar 3 piores em 4–5 dias.
Sem transcrição frame a frame dos criativos dos concorrentes nesta rodada — modelar a estrutura observável, não copiar copy.
Nunca usar imagem, logo ou estampa proprietária de concorrente.
